sensory.aromaNotes: Mild, faintly fruity; clean cooked aroma with light mushroom note
sensory.meatAnalogRationale: Long fibrous stipes shred and bind in Asian meat-analog and hybrid products; protein-rich dry matter supports partial meat replacement.
sensory.preparationContext: Fresh clusters, blanched or stir-fried; stems used as shreds
sensory.confidenceNotes: Sensory and nutrition grounded in Food Chemistry analyses of fruiting bodies.

morphology.fruitingBodyStructure: Clustered basidiocarps with minute convex pileus and elongated hollow stipe; free to adnexed gills
morphology.microscopyNotes: Clamp connections present; thin-walled generative hyphae in stipe trama

nutrition.preparationContext: Values on dry-weight basis for cultivated fruiting bodies unless noted
nutrition.confidenceNotes: Proximate composition from peer-reviewed enoki nutrition studies.

geographic.cultivatedRegions: Japan, China, Korea, Europe, North America
geographic.habitat: Saprotroph on hardwood stumps and logs

strains.availabilityNotes: Add verified culture collection strain for Flammulina velutipes.

commercialUse.applicationSummary: One of the world's most cultivated mushrooms; fibrous stems used in stir-fries, hot pots, and emerging hybrid meat-analog formulations.

productionProcess.title: Bottle / bag cultivation
productionProcess.description: Sawdust or corn-cob substrate in bottles; cold forcing produces elongated stipes characteristic of commercial enoki.

commercialUse.confidenceNotes: Global commodity crop with documented protein composition.

regulatory.notes: Longstanding cultivated edible mushroom; traditional food use in East Asia and globally traded.

altProteinResearch.title: Nutritional composition and antioxidant properties of Flammulina velutipes
altProteinResearch.summary: Documents high protein and essential amino acids in enoki fruiting bodies — foundational for using F. velutipes as an alt-protein co-ingredient.

altProteinResearch.title: Edible mushrooms as functional ingredients for meat analogues
altProteinResearch.summary: Positions cultivated mushrooms including Flammulina among fungal biomass sources for meat-analog texture and umami.
